To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the majority of Norwegian and Swedish parliamentarians are using social media services in a rather modest way.

(1) the majority of Norwegian and Swedish politicians have a Facebook and Twitter account; (2) they post and tweet on a daily basis; (3) they use these services for a variety of purposes, including political and non-political ones; and (4) they are more active on Twitter than Facebook, but they are also more active on Facebook than Twitter than their constituents.
